## Activity

During June 2023, West Gate Eye Clinic recorded 401 captures. This report summarises activity for the site and presents the associated image-quality and grading results. The capture total provides the basis for reviewing the volume submitted for assessment during the month. The activity recorded at West Gate Eye Clinic is reported as a single monthly total.

## Image quality

Of the captures recorded, 12 were ungradable. The ungradable rate was 3.0. This measure indicates the proportion of submitted images that could not be used for grading. The result is reported alongside the number of ungradable captures to provide both the rate and the corresponding count for the month. Image-quality performance for West Gate Eye Clinic is therefore presented through these two measures.

## Grading

Grading identified 95 referable results from the captures submitted during June 2023. The median lag from capture to grading was 2. This provides the central measure of the time taken for grading across the month. Together, the referable result count and median lag describe the grading outcome and timeliness recorded for West Gate Eye Clinic.
